responsibility: This target header defines the 64-bit bare-metal SPARC ELF configuration. It selects default 64-bit V9 target masks and the embmedany code model, provides minimal assembler/link/startfile/endfile specs for standalone ELF environments, and fixes ABI-visible type properties such as 16-bit wchar_t and 128-bit long double, distinguishing it from the 32-bit embedded sp-elf.h configuration.
